places.name: Hat Creek cow camp
places.note: Newt night-herds and dreams of the north; cowboys gamble future wages by the fire; Deets, uneasy about the hasty drive, builds branding fires with Newt and Pea.
places.location_hint: valley near the Rio Grande, about five miles from Lonesome Dove, in mesquite and chaparral brush

places.name: Rio Grande
places.note: Newt and Sean rest beside it after branding while Sean talks about his family.

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Jake keeps slipping off to town; Deets is sad to be leaving its steady, quiet life.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande, near the cow camp

places.name: San Antonio
places.note: The only city Newt has seen, on one of Deets's banking trips.

places.name: Matagorda
places.note: Newt saw the ocean there when helping deliver horses with Deets and Pea.
places.location_hint: Texas Gulf Coast around Matagorda Bay

places.name: Great Plains
places.note: Newt imagines its endless grass, buffalo, elk and bears; Deets recalls water holes drying fast there in summer.
places.location_hint: the northern plains the drive will cross

places.name: Ireland
places.note: Sean describes his seaside village, carpet-thick grass and few cows; his violent father drowned in a well.

places.name: Mexico
places.note: Bert says cheaper women can be had across the river there.

places.name: Ogallala
places.note: Augustus says the young hands must wait for it, rumored to be a sinful town.

places.name: Fort Worth
places.note: Jasper compares Ogallala's reputation to it.

groups.label: Cow camp
groups.hint: building branding fires and holding the herd near the river about five miles from Lonesome Dove; drive due to start within days

groups.label: Jake Spoon
groups.hint: slipped off from camp to town again
